name: idle-vivarium-ferns-day-sa
refs: IMAGE 1, THE APPROVED CONCEPT (the owner's pick, option A): the room's planting, palette, mood and light; never its case, frame or box:
prompt: Output a NEW image, 16:9. Image 1 is the owner's approved concept for this room. Paint THIS room as a finished painting: the same planting, palette, mood and light as Image 1, but showing ONLY the inside of the terrarium, edge to edge, wide, from a low eye height, straight on: no case, no bezel, no frame, no window posts, no box, no ceiling, no side walls of a box, no glass edges. Finish: a hand-painted miniature diorama, fine painterly grain on everything, the back softly out of focus with gentle bokeh, the floor sharp; believable materials; never photographic, never toon, never childish, no cartoon outlines, no toy colours, no gloss, no glow, no chrome, no alien tech. No creatures, no animals, no figures, no text, no letters, no digits, no logos, no UI. No pool, no pond, no open water surface, no cliff, no crag, no ledge. LAYOUT, as fractions of the picture: the open floor's back edge (where the open floor ends and everything taller begins) runs at about 80 percent of the height down from the top over the left tenth of the width, about 76 percent from 10 to 32 percent of the width, about 70 percent from 32 to 55 percent, about 71 percent from 55 to 88 percent, and about 75 percent over the right eighth; it may sit a little higher, never lower. Below that edge, down to about 97 percent of the height, is the OPEN FLOOR: low, CALM and plain, nothing on it taller than a small pebble, no scatter of litter, debris or stones, no roots or stems lying across it, so small dark, brown and teal creatures read clearly on it. The bottom 3 percent is a thin dark soil strip across the full width. Everything tall stands BEHIND the back edge, its feet ending on it, never spilling onto the floor. EXCEPT TWO LOW FOREGROUND PIECES at the very front of the floor, their bases at about 94 to 96 percent of the height, each no wider than a tenth of the width and no taller than about 8 percent of the height: one between about 12 and 30 percent of the width, one between about 68 and 85 percent. Nothing important between 57 and 65 percent of the width in the lowest fifth. FITTINGS are incidental: small, half in shadow, off-centre, standing at or behind the back edge, never in the open floor and never as hoses or pipes along the side edges; each small, no more than about 7 percent of the width and a fifth of the height. THE ROOM: a shaded fern dell, as in Image 1: a deep green fern bank with golden flecks of sun, dappled green-gold light, cool shade, a mossy fallen log lying along the back edge (from about 15 to 60 percent of the width), its underside on the back edge. The ceramic fogger bowl is made SMALL: about 6 percent of the width, half hidden behind the log at the right of centre, a low soft fog drifting from it along the back only, never over the open floor. Two or three very thin copper drip lines hang in the shade among the fronds, one drop at a tip. The floor short moss and dark peat with only two or three flat leaves. No tree trunks, no forest: it is a terrarium planting. The two foreground pieces: a low fern tuft (left) and a small clump of curled croziers (right).
